title: AP Bio Students Used as Examples for Ms. Chan’s AP Psychology Class
issue: National Homemade Bread Day Edition | Issue #2
author: Axel D. Tissue
description: AP Bio students exhibit symptoms of madness and are used in AP Psychology demonstrations.
content:
National Homemade Bread Day Edition | November 17th, 2025 | Issue #2
Read, Write, Join at StuyvesantSpeculator.com

Freshman AP Bio is a class renowned for its difficulty and sleep-schedule-ruining power. Only the smartest, bravest, and brightest students even attempt the course, after they have passed the admission exam. These students are the best of the best. However, after the end of Unit 2 (Biochemistry), AP Bio students have been complaining of visions, sudden attacks of anxiety and depression, and many other symptoms of the common madman.

Ms. Chan, a beloved teacher by both her FRAP students and AP Psychology students alike, has taken this opportunity to heal and teach at the same time. However, things haven’t been going quite so well. Freshman AP Biology students have been seen being used in demonstrations to teach the effects of psychosis and sleep deprivation to young and brooding students of AP Psychology. FRAP Students are given 0.076 extra credit points if they sign numerous forms, forfeit their 8th Amendment rights, and volunteer to be test subjects. The deranged freshmen are also being used for the “adopt a freshie” project, where the older Psychology students are meant to help out the FRAP kids and improve their mental health. As of now, there has been zero improvement, and half of the kids state they feel “much worse” than before the project started. Chan has commented that “If an opportunity arises, I must take it! Although I do worry for my students…”.

Has Ms. Chan gone too far? It seems so. AP Psychology students struggle to deal with the difficult cases of the AP Bio students, and it often leads to outbreaks of violence or at least prolonged shouting matches. Ms Chan suggests that her Freshman AP Bio students take her Psychology class in the future, so that they can have the same experience.

title: Staten Island Declares War on New York City
issue: National Homemade Bread Day Edition | Issue #2
author: Richard Kiselev
description: Staten Island secedes, forms a navy, and bombards Coney Island.
content:
Staten Island, long frowned upon by the rest of New York City, seceded from the union and declared war on New York City last night. At 2:30 AM on November 16th, Staten Island Troopers (a new division founded to “defend the republic”) placed explosives on the Verrezano Bridge and blew it up, shattering the main connection between Staten Island and the rest of the city. Troopers also took all 9 ships in the Staten Island Ferry fleet hostage. With these ships, Borough President Vito Fossella has founded a navy to defend the island. At 4:00 AM, Fossella led a bombardment of Coney Island, lobbing stones at confused joggers from the ferries.

Staten Islanders are mixed on the change. Marigold Ganner, a 58 year old woman said that in her opinion, the secession would “Make Staten Island Great Again”. This rallying cry can be spotted all over the island on signs, banners, and in the windows of Italian restaurants. However, experts claim it is a fallacious slogan, since everyone agrees Staten Island was never great.

title: Alec’s Amazing Appetizers – Dictatorship Cupcakes!
issue: National Homemade Bread Day Edition | Issue #2
author: Alec Tiseo
description: A cupcake recipe themed around Principal Yu.
content:
As our workload continues to get worse and worse and the Spectator continues to spread Principal Yu’s propaganda, I’d like to share some special recipes that will help us all make it through this year (and the next 3)!

Dictatorship Cupcakes

Prep Time: 30 minutes to 4 hours (depends on how much you procrastinate)
Serves: 3500 hungry hungry hippos students
Ingredients: 0.354882 liters of flour, however many tears you can muster (should be a lot), 22.1801 milliliters of baking powder, 0.003252634 imperial quarts of salt, sugar and some other stuff (butter eggs vanilla extract - just figure it out)

Instructions:
1. Heat an oven to -3.715 Degrees Wedgewood
2. In a medium bowl, mix tears, tears, tears, tears, absence of free will, flour, baking powder, and salt.
3. In an electric mixer, beat the Spectator’s undying truth (and the granulated sugar and butter together until white and fluffy)
4. Add the tear mixture in until every sense of individuality is stripped from you by Our Glorious Savior And Princi-pal. (Because he is a PAL of the people!)
5. Bake for 15 minutes, and serve fresh!
6. (Optional) Create an image of Principal Yu’s face with icing for extra social credit!!

title: Stuyvesant Soviet Party Sees Success in Early Polls
issue: National Homemade Bread Day Edition | Issue #2
author: Richard Kiselev
description: A socialist party rises in the Stuyvesant caucus elections.
content:
The Stuyvesant Soviet Party has been seeing record-high numbers in recent caucus polls. While the WE-GIVE-YOU-FREE-STUFF Party and the Pizza Party still dominate the current predictions, a socialist party is reaching record-highs. The Stuyvesant Socialist Party, or SSP, has numerous ambitious plans for Stuyvesant. In a written statement, the chairman of the party, Kingston G. Baranov (signing the letter by his initials), declared that when the SSP wins the elections, they will “create a Union of Soviet Stuyvesant Researchers”. Their exact goals aren’t clear, but members of the party express a clear desire to “free the working students” and “eat the ones with the highest GPAs". Numerous members have also expressed a desire to annex nearby schools, until the entirety of New York City is one glorious Soviet state. In order to enact these reforms, members of the SSP will need to win elections for every grade, which seems unlikely but is nevertheless possible.p

Principal Yu stated on Friday that the party and its plans“will only harm students”. He then claimed that there was “no need to worry”, since the SSP stood no chance at winning the caucus elections. Regardless, he officially formed a Stuyvesant Committee on Un-American Activities yesterday, headed by beloved library rat Chester “Squeals” McCarthy.

title: College Board Introduces Microtransactions for 2026 Testing Season
author: Richard Kiselev
description: The College Board is adding microtransactions to the SAT, PSAT, and AP exams.
content:
The College Board, known for producing, distributing, and managing the SAT, PSAT, and AP exams, has announced that they will be phasing in microtransactions for the 2026 “Testing Season”.

“We brought in more than a billion dollars last year, but to tell you the truth, it’s barely enough to keep the lights on”, claimed College Board president David Coleman.

Among the purchases soon to be offered by the College Board are “Time Boosters”, the “AP Pass”, and “Point Packages” ranging from “Handful of Points” ($4.99) to “Mountain of Points” ($99.99). The decision has come under fire from teachers and students calling the microtransactions “pay-to-win”. This policy might give poorer students a clear disadvantage against their wealthier peers.

“We hear you”, claims Coleman. “That’s why we’re allowing students to still take the test for free!”

A College Board representative confirmed that the free version of the SAT, PSAT, and all AP exams will have unskippable video advertisements between questions. The College Board claims that the advertisements will allow students to take breaks in between questions. How the ads will affect test-taking timing strategy is unknown. However, the Board has confirmed an “Ad-Away” option for “opportunistic” students ($19.99).

title: Peter Stuyvesant Portrait on Second Floor Removed, Riot Kills 10
author: Alec Tiseo
description: Removal of the Peter Stuyvesant portrait sparks riots.
content:
Peter Stuyvesant is known and beloved by all Stuyvesant students (some more than others) as the namesake of this great school. And any Stuyvesant student could probably tell you about the portrait of him that hangs on the second floor, directly overlooking the half-floor (and our school's motto, Pro Scientia Atque Sapientia).

Peter Stuyvesant has also been the catalyst of a certain “cult” of worshippers that revere the great Dutchman, and they are often very fervent about their worship. So you can imagine the outrage when a group of students scheming against the cult of Peter Stuyvesant took the portrait down.

As the portrait is a site for daily prayer for many members of the Cult of Peter Stuyvesant, its absence was noticed soon after it was taken. Cultists, overtaken by rage, flooded the halls, forcing students to barricade themselves in classrooms and bathrooms.

At the end, 10 Stuyvesant students were killed, and 20 were injured, including beloved community member Retep Tnasevyuts. The riot finally ended when Principal Yu declared martial law upon the school, and rioting cultists were forced into classrooms by weapon-toting members of SU. Principal Yu declines to comment about the incident.

title: New Hampshire Real Estate Prices Soar As Billionaires Buy
author: Richard Kiselev
description: After the mayoral election, New Hampshire mansions are snapped up at a record pace.
content:
After Zohran Mamdani won the 2025 mayoral race, New Hampshire real estate prices have skyrocketed almost 500% in 30 minutes. A spokesman from Zillow stated that on average, a mansion is being bought in the state every thirty seconds. The Speculator’s Investigative Journalism team interviewed Mr. S. M. Duck, a self-proclaimed “upper-middle class working man” who just bought a 35.2 floor “cottage”.

“You see, once that ‘Mazda’ guy takes charge, he’s gonna hurt us working men, he’s a hater, that’s what he is!”

In response to the exodus, Mamdani has reportedly “waved bye-bye” to the billionaires. However, it remains unclear if there will be any rich left to tax before Saturday.

Both New Yorkers and New Hampshirers have mixed feelings.
“We don’t want those capitalist pigs here!” proclaimed 9-year-old Владимир Ленин while sitting in his sandbox.
“Well, Vladimir, if we get those pigs to settle here, we can tax them to death!” responded his mother, Ms. Valentina Lenin.
“So, we capture the pigs… and eat the cало!”, cried little Ленин. (сало is an Eastern European food consisting of cured pork fat)
“Now you’re thinking like a true communist!” said Ms. Lenin.

Even though New Yorkers and New Hampshirers might not feel the same way, Old Yorkers and Old Hampshirers both welcome the change.

title: Richard’s Recipes: Sadness Soup
author: Richard Kiselev
description: A Siberian tradition to be even more depressed in the winter.
content:
Hello readers! It’s November, and that means saying “goodbye” to October and “hello” to November! When it was so cold that the air froze in the depths of Siberia, a nice bowl of Sadness Soup made me and my family feel even more terrible! Today, I’ll give you the great familial recipe, passed down for generations.

Sadness Soup (adapted from lovecookingxoxo.com)
Ingredients
684 Quintillion Molecules of Water (you can just TASTE the polar covalent bonds)
1 Grain of Salt (if using tears for water, leave out)
100 Bushels of Bay Leaves (adds SO much depth to your depression)
Instructions
Take out a pot.
Insert 683 quintillion, 999 quadrillion, 999 trillion, 999 billion, 999 million, 999,999 water molecules into the pot.
Boil the water molecules with the salt and the bay leaves.
When the bay leaves soak up all the water, transfer the bay leaves to an industrial-size blender.
Blend the leaves and strain out the solids until you have Bay Leaf Juice™.
Garnish with the final water molecule.
(Don’t) enjoy!
